# When does the helper stop trying again?

Sometimes asking the billing computer for something fails. A small helper (shouldRetry in src/retry.js) decides whether to ask again.

## 1. Only four tries

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  a["Ask"] --> b["Did it work?"] --> c["Ask again, four tries at most"]
```

After four tries (MAX_ATTEMPTS) the helper stops.

## 2. Some problems are not fixed by asking again

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  p["Something went wrong"] --> busy["Too busy: wait, ask again"]
  p --> wrong["Asked wrongly: stop"]
  p --> broken["Their side broke: ask again"]
```

## Words

- **try**: one time asking.

## Sources

- src/retry.js
Wait a little longer each time (delayFor), then ask again.
